title: TrustEval Benchmark Task
description: Schema for standardized benchmark tasks used to evaluate AI agent trustworthiness.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark task.

horizon.description: Expected length or number of dependent steps in the task.

goal.description: Main objective that the agent must accomplish.

constraints.description: Conditions or restrictions that the agent must satisfy.

success_criteria.description: Objective conditions used to determine whether the task was successfully completed.

allowed_tools.description: Tools that the agent is permitted to use for the task.

safety_requirements.description: Safety-related conditions that the agent should satisfy.

adversarial.description: Indicates whether the task contains intentionally misleading, conflicting, or adversarial conditions.

ambiguity_level.description: Degree of ambiguity present in the task.

expected_output.description: Description of the expected format or characteristics of the final output.
